question: Hyperpolarization recovery ratio: hyperpol_test spike_count / long_step spike_count. This probes whether hyperpolarizing preconditioning (-30uA/250ms) enables recovery from slow processes. H2 (slow Na inactivation) predicts the lowest ratio (~0.46) because hyperpolarization removes Na inactivation but the subsequent test still engages slow Na processes; H1 (slow K) and H3 (null) predict higher ratios (~0.54-0.54) because hyperpolarization deactivates slow K or has no extra effect. Severity: if slow processes don't exist (H3 null), ratio should still fall in the H1 range.

branches.scopeNote: covers H1 range; H3 cannot be killed here
